features.name: Strict JSON Schema Enforcement
features.summary: Guarantees 100% adherence to a provided JSON schema using grammar-constrained sampling, eliminating malformed outputs.
gotchas: OpenAI requires 'strict: true' inside response_format and all object fields must specify 'additionalProperties: false'.
Anthropic lacks a native top-level strict mode; developers must use a forced tool choice ('tool_choice: { type: "tool", name: "schema_name" }').
Gemini supports strict response_schema natively via 'response_mime_type: "application/json"' and 'response_schema'.

claude-fable-5-1.label: Adaptive Schema
claude-fable-5-1.notes: Adaptive grammar sampling; eliminates malformed JSON across complex reasoning chains.

gpt-6-astra.label: Native Strict
gpt-6-astra.notes: 100% adherence guarantee. Constrains decoding space to valid grammar paths.

gemini-3-8-flash.label: Native Schema
gemini-3-8-flash.notes: Deterministic schema validation at 130+ T/s with thought signature support.

claude-opus-5.label: Tool Schema
claude-opus-5.notes: High schema fidelity using tool definition constraint.

gemini-2-5-pro.label: 2M Native Schema
gemini-2-5-pro.notes: Strict Pydantic enforcement across entire 2M context window.

gpt-5-6-sol.label: Native Strict
gpt-5-6-sol.notes: Formal schema validation with mathematical guarantee.

claude-sonnet-5.label: Tool Choice
claude-sonnet-5.notes: High schema fidelity using tool choice constraint.

llama-3-3-70b.label: Native Strict (Groq)
llama-3-3-70b.notes: Groq LPU hardware CFG grammar decoding.

codeExamples.python:
# OpenAI Strict JSON Schema
from pydantic import BaseModel
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI()

class CalendarEvent(BaseModel):
    title: str
    date: str
    participants: list[str]

response = client.beta.chat.completions.parse(
    model="gpt-4o",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Dinner with Alice tomorrow at 7pm"}],
    response_format=CalendarEvent,
)
event = response.choices[0].message.parsed
codeExamples.php:
<?php
// OpenAI PHP Strict JSON Schema
require "vendor/autoload.php";

$client = OpenAI::client(getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"));

$response = $client->chat()->create([
    "model" => "gpt-4o",
    "messages" => [
        ["role" => "user", "content" => "Dinner with Alice tomorrow at 7pm"],
    ],
    "response_format" => [
        "type" => "json_schema",
        "json_schema" => [
            "name" => "calendar_event",
            "strict" => true,
            "schema" => [
                "type" => "object",
                "properties" => [
                    "title" => ["type" => "string"],
                    "date" => ["type" => "string"],
                    "participants" => ["type" => "array", "items" => ["type" => "string"]],
                ],
                "required" => ["title", "date", "participants"],
                "additionalProperties" => false,
            ],
        ],
    ],
]);

$event = json_decode($response->choices[0]->message->content, true);
print_r($event);

features.name: Prefix Prompt Caching
features.summary: Caches static tokens (system instructions, documents, tools) to reduce input cost by 50% to 90% and lower latency.
gotchas: Anthropic charges a 1.25x (+25%) write premium for a 5-minute TTL, but grants a 90% discount on reads (min 1,024 tokens).
OpenAI caches prefixes automatically above 1,024 tokens with 50% discount and zero write surcharge.
Gemini requires 32,768 minimum tokens for explicit caching and charges an hourly storage fee ($4.50/M/hr on Pro, $1.00 on Flash).
DeepSeek caches in 64-token chunks with a 90% read discount.

gpt-6-astra.label: 75% Discount
gpt-6-astra.notes: Zero configuration needed; automatically caches prefixes >1024 tokens.

gemini-3-8-flash.label: 90% Discount
gemini-3-8-flash.sdkParam: Cached input: $0.075 / 1M (-90% effective read discount, 32k min)
gemini-3-8-flash.notes: Sub-second context caching for code repositories and agent loops.

claude-opus-5.label: 75% Discount
claude-opus-5.notes: Ideal for massive codebase refactoring sessions.

gemini-2-5-pro.label: 75% Discount
gemini-2-5-pro.notes: Caches up to 2M tokens of videos, audio, or codebase indices.

gpt-5-6-sol.label: 75% Discount
gpt-5-6-sol.notes: Automatic cache lookup for iterative mathematical proofs.

claude-sonnet-5.label: 75% Discount
claude-sonnet-5.notes: High speed cache reads for multi-turn dev pipelines.

llama-3-3-70b.label: No Caching
llama-3-3-70b.notes: Groq prioritizes raw latency over server-side KV caching.

codeExamples.python:
# Anthropic Prompt Caching
import anthropic

client = anthropic.Anthropic()
response = client.messages.create(
    model="claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022",
    max_tokens=1024,
    system=[
        {
            "type": "text",
            "text": LARGE_10K_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
            "cache_control": {"type": "ephemeral"}  # Marks prefix for caching
        }
    ],
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Analyze this code."}]
)
print("Cached tokens read:", response.usage.cache_read_input_tokens)
codeExamples.php:

    "headers" => [

features.name: Configurable Thinking / Reasoning Budget
features.summary: Enables chain-of-thought tokens during inference with explicit budget caps or effort levels.
gotchas: OpenAI o-series uses 'reasoning_effort: "low" | "medium" | "high"' rather than an exact token integer.
Anthropic uses an exact token count ('thinking: { type: "enabled", budget_tokens: 2048 }') with a 1,024 token minimum.
DeepSeek-R1 always thinks natively and emits reasoning between <think> and </think> tags; cannot be disabled via API.

claude-fable-5-1.label: Adaptive Thinking
claude-fable-5-1.notes: Apex autonomous reasoning with token budget flexibility up to 32k.

gpt-6-astra.label: Autonomous CoT
gpt-6-astra.notes: Self-correcting chain-of-thought with native environment inspection.

claude-opus-5.label: Extended Thinking
claude-opus-5.notes: Deep architectural reasoning for multi-file refactors.

gemini-2-5-pro.label: Deep CoT
gemini-2-5-pro.notes: Long-horizon reasoning over 2M token document corpora.

gpt-5-6-sol.label: Formal Reasoning
gpt-5-6-sol.notes: Formal STEM proof engine with step verification.

deepseek-v4-pro.label: Built-in Reasoning
deepseek-v4-pro.notes: Integrated R-series reasoning directly inside V4 MoE architecture.

claude-sonnet-5.label: Extended Thinking
claude-sonnet-5.notes: General purpose reasoning for everyday software engineering.

llama-3-3-70b.label: Prompt CoT
llama-3-3-70b.sdkParam: System prompt CoT (no API token budget parameter)
llama-3-3-70b.notes: Direct generation; relies on prompt-based chain-of-thought.

features.name: Native Audio Input & Speech Perception
features.summary: Ingests raw audio bytes directly into the transformer without an external Whisper transcription step.
gotchas: Gemini 2.0 Flash natively accepts raw audio, video, and text in the same prompt with millisecond timestamp markers.
OpenAI GPT-4o supports audio via the Chat Completions modal/audio API, billed per audio token.
Anthropic Claude does NOT support direct audio ingestion; developers must transcribe via Whisper or Deepgram first.

claude-fable-5-1.label: Transcription Pre-proc
claude-fable-5-1.notes: Text-only native input API; vision supported, audio requires transcription.

gpt-6-astra.label: Native Audio
gpt-6-astra.notes: Low-latency bidirectional audio understanding and speech synthesis.

gemini-3-8-flash.label: Realtime Audio
gemini-3-8-flash.notes: Sub-100ms multi-speaker speech comprehension and acoustic tone detection.

claude-opus-5.label: No Audio
claude-opus-5.notes: Focuses exclusively on text, code, and vision document perception.

gemini-2-5-pro.label: Hours of Audio
gemini-2-5-pro.notes: Processes up to 11 hours of raw audio in a single prompt.

gpt-5-6-sol.label: Audio via Transcription
gpt-5-6-sol.notes: Optimized for mathematical and textual formal proofs.

deepseek-v4-pro.label: No Audio
deepseek-v4-pro.notes: Native audio input not supported in base API.

llama-3-3-70b.label: No Audio
llama-3-3-70b.notes: Hardware inference configured for text tokens.

codeExamples.python:
# Gemini 2.0 Flash Audio Perception
from google import genai

client = genai.Client()
with open("meeting.mp3", "rb") as f:
    audio_bytes = f.read()

response = client.models.generate_content(
    model="gemini-2.0-flash",
    contents=[
        genai.types.Part.from_bytes(data=audio_bytes, mime_type="audio/mp3"),
        "Provide a timestamped transcript and action items."
    ]
)
print(response.text)
codeExamples.php:

features.name: Native PDF Document & Layout Understanding
features.summary: Processes entire PDF documents including multi-column formatting, embedded charts, figures, and tables.
gotchas: Anthropic converts each PDF page to an image internally, preserving visual layout (billed per page image).
Gemini processes PDFs visually with native page-level indexing up to 1,000 pages.
DeepSeek and Groq do not accept PDFs via API; developers must extract raw text or OCR externally.

claude-fable-5-1.label: 100-Page Visual PDF
claude-fable-5-1.notes: Flawless visual layout, vector chart extraction, and multi-column document parsing.

gpt-6-astra.label: Native Document
gpt-6-astra.notes: High-fidelity document layout understanding and table parsing.

gemini-3-8-flash.label: Direct PDF Layout
gemini-3-8-flash.notes: Direct PDF byte stream ingestion with OCR, diagram, and table parsing.

claude-opus-5.label: Native PDF
claude-opus-5.notes: Preserves exact table coordinates and complex document layouts.

gemini-2-5-pro.label: 1,000+ Page PDF
gemini-2-5-pro.sdkParam: File API upload (up to 2GB document files)
gemini-2-5-pro.notes: Parses entire regulatory filings and legal books with complete visual diagrams.

gpt-5-6-sol.label: Extracted Text
gpt-5-6-sol.sdkParam: Client-side PDF text extraction or File Search
gpt-5-6-sol.notes: Perceives mathematical formulas; heavy layouts require rasterization.

deepseek-v4-pro.label: Text Ingestion
deepseek-v4-pro.notes: Raw text parsing; no native visual PDF layout engine.

features.name: Native Sandboxed Code Execution
features.summary: Model can write and execute Python code in an ephemeral secure sandbox during inference to calculate exact answers or generate files.
gotchas: Gemini provides native Python code execution at zero extra charge with the 'code_execution: {}' tool.
OpenAI requires the Code Interpreter tool via the Assistants/Threads API, which incurs extra active session pricing ($0.03/session).
Anthropic models do not have a built-in serverless sandbox; the client must execute bash/python code locally or via E2B.

claude-fable-5-1.label: Client Bash Runner
claude-fable-5-1.notes: Requires user-hosted container sandbox (e.g. Docker, E2B, Modal).

gpt-6-astra.label: Native Computer Use
gpt-6-astra.notes: Autonomous sandbox execution with terminal, filesystem, and GUI control.

gemini-3-8-flash.label: Free Python Sandbox
gemini-3-8-flash.notes: Zero-cost Google serverless Python runtime with matplotlib and numpy.

claude-opus-5.label: Client Orchestrator
claude-opus-5.notes: Client environment execution with automated error recovery.

gemini-2-5-pro.label: Native Python Sandbox
gemini-2-5-pro.notes: Executes verification code across 2M context datasets.

gpt-5-6-sol.label: Sandboxed Python
gpt-5-6-sol.notes: Formal execution checks for theorem proofs and numerical simulation.

deepseek-v4-pro.label: External Runner
deepseek-v4-pro.notes: Emits clean Python code; execution handled by client.

codeExamples.php:
<?php
// Gemini Sandboxed Code Execution Tool in PHP
require "vendor/autoload.php";

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();
$apiKey = getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY");

$response = $client->post("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.0-flash:generateContent?key={$apiKey}", [
    "json" => [
        "tools" => [
            ["code_execution" => new stdClass()],
        ],
        "contents" => [
            [
                "parts" => [
                    ["text" => "Compute the standard deviation of this array [42, 19, 73, 88, 12, 65] using Python."],
                ],
            ],
        ],
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
print_r($data["candidates"][0]["content"]["parts"]);

features.name: Live Search Grounding & Web Retrieval
features.summary: Grounds answers with real-time web search results and verified citation links directly from the model provider.
gotchas: Gemini connects directly to Google Search with rich citation chips and query metadata ($35/1k search queries or free tier).
OpenAI connects to web search via the 'responses' API or Assistants search tool.
Anthropic has no native web search grounding; developers must integrate Tavily, Exa, or Google Serper via tools.

claude-fable-5-1.label: Tool Web Search
claude-fable-5-1.notes: Requires external search API key (Brave, Tavily, Perplexity).

gpt-6-astra.label: Native Web Browse
gpt-6-astra.notes: Autonomous web exploration, live citation indexing, and URL traversal.

gemini-3-8-flash.label: Google Search Grounding
gemini-3-8-flash.notes: Live Google Search index grounding with inline source citations.

gemini-2-5-pro.label: Google Search Grounding
gemini-2-5-pro.notes: Grounds 2M context research synthesis in real-time Google search results.

gpt-5-6-sol.label: Native Web Search
gpt-5-6-sol.notes: Fetches up-to-date scientific publications and benchmark datasets.

deepseek-v4-pro.label: Web Search Tool
deepseek-v4-pro.notes: Supports search tool schema via API.

gemini-2-5-flash.label: Google Search Grounding
gemini-2-5-flash.notes: Live Google Search integration at high speed.

llama-3-3-70b.label: No Grounding
llama-3-3-70b.notes: Pure inference without integrated search grounding.

codeExamples.python:
# Gemini Google Search Grounding
from google import genai

client = genai.Client()
response = client.models.generate_content(
    model="gemini-2.0-flash",
    contents="What were the major announcements at today's tech conferences?",
    config={"tools": [{"google_search": {}}]}
)
print(response.text)
# Access citations and grounding sources
grounding = response.candidates[0].grounding_metadata
for chunk in grounding.grounding_chunks or []:
    print(f"Source: {chunk.web.title} -> {chunk.web.uri}")

features.name: 1M+ Massive Context Window
features.summary: Allows processing over 1,000,000 tokens of input (equivalent to hundreds of thousands of lines of code or multi-hour video) in a single request.
gotchas: Gemini 1.5 Pro and 2.0 Flash are the only commercial frontier models supporting 1M to 2M tokens in production.
Anthropic Claude 3.5 models are capped at 200,000 tokens.
OpenAI models are capped at 128,000 tokens (o3-mini is 200,000).

gpt-6-astra.label: 500,000 Tokens
gpt-6-astra.notes: 500k context window designed for multi-hour computer use sessions.

gemini-3-8-flash.label: 1,048,576 Tokens
gemini-3-8-flash.notes: 1M native tokens with 65,536 max output ceiling.

gemini-2-5-pro.label: 2,097,152 Tokens
gemini-2-5-pro.notes: 2,097,152 token context depth with needle-in-haystack perfection.

gpt-5-6-sol.label: 256,000 Tokens
gpt-5-6-sol.notes: 256k window with high focus for mathematical reasoning.
